description:
Find a store

A token's creator store and the items it sells (active ones only): each item's name, type, price and currency, stock, and per-wallet limit. It looks the store up by `symbol`, or by token page (`chainKey` and `crownId`) when a ticker is registered on several chains. 404 means the token has no store. Buying happens on the token's page on chaindaddy.io.

chainKey.description: The registration's chain key, e.g. base. With crownId.

crownId.description: The registration's token ID on that chain. With chainKey.

name: find_store

appBps.description: On an app's item, the developer's share of each sale after the fee, in basis points, as the page's owner accepted it

appId.description:
On an item an installed app sells on the page: the app's id. Such an item is locked: the page's managers
and store keys cannot change, grant or archive it (409 `APP_ITEM_LOCKED`). Its `sku` starts with
`app.`, a prefix no other item may use.

appItemKey.description: On an app's item, the app's own key for it

appTermsVersion.description: On an app's item, the version of its terms the page's owner accepted

currency.description:
What the SKU is paid in: `token`, the store's own token (the default); `native`, the chain's coin;
or `usdc`, the chain's dollar stable (USDG on Robinhood Chain).

currencyAddress.description: The currency's address (the zero address for an EVM coin, `11111111111111111111111111111111` for SOL)

grants.description: A bundle. Buying it grants these items instead of itself.

maxAppSpend.description: Consumables only. Lets apps on the token page spend this item for the wallet that holds it (the `iap-consume` app action), at most this many in one request. `null`, the default: no app can spend it, only a store key.

maxPrice.description: With `priceUsdMicros`, the most one unit may cost, in base units of the SKU's currency

minPrice.description: With `priceUsdMicros`, the least one unit may cost, in base units of the SKU's currency

price.description:
Price in base units of the SKU's currency. Null means not for sale (reward-only or unlock).
On a dollar-priced SKU this is null in the creator's reads; in the public catalog it is the
amount for one unit at the current rate (`priceIsEstimate: true`; exact for `usdc`), or null
when no price is available right now.

priceIsEstimate.description:
Public catalog only, and only on a dollar-priced SKU paid in the token or the coin: `price` is an
indicative conversion, not a quote. The order locks the amount the buyer pays.

priceUsdMicros.description:
A USD price per unit in millionths of a dollar ($5 = 5000000), instead of `price`. Each order
converts it to an exact amount of the SKU's currency and locks it: exactly for `usdc`; for
`token` or `native` at the live price (mean of the last 2 minutes of 15-second readings), rounded
up to 4 significant figures and clamped to `minPrice`/`maxPrice`.

allOf.description:
One node of the rule language shared by purchase gates, unlocks and drop audiences. Each node has
exactly one key: `all` or `any` (a list of rules), `not` (a rule), `hold` (`{min, token?, chainId?}`:
a balance of at least `min` base units of the store's token, or of `token` on `chainId`), or `owns`
(`{sku, min?}`: holds at least `min` of an item, default 1). Up to 4 levels deep and 32 nodes.

rule.description: A purchase gate, or for `unlock` the condition that holds it

splits.description: Revenue splits; absent or null when there are none. On an update, null clears them. Only the store owner's session may change them (403 SPLITS_OWNER_ONLY otherwise); sending them back unchanged is allowed.

items.description: A revenue split: `bps` of the creator's share of each sale (the price after any platform fee), paid to `address` in the buyer's same payment. At most 2 per SKU (3 when the store pays no fee), together at most 9999.

address.description: A wallet on the store's chain; not the store payout, the fee recipient or the checkout

amount.description: On an order and a receipt only, the base units this split was paid

type.description:
`consumable` adds to a balance; `non_consumable` is owned once; `timed` extends an expiry by
`durationSeconds` per unit; `unlock` is never sold and is held while its `rule` holds.

feeBps.description: What Chain Daddy takes from each sale, in basis points (0 on tokens launched in a Chain Daddy launchpad pool)

live.description:
False when the wallet that opened the store no longer has a paid plan. The store then takes no new orders
for its own items; items from apps installed on the page keep selling.

payoutAddress.description: Where sales pay out (default the token page owner)

price.description:
The token's live dollar rate: what a dollar-priced SKU paid in the token would convert at now.
Either `usdPerToken`, `source` and `asOf`, or `unavailable` with the reason an order would be
refused `PRICE_UNAVAILABLE`. Separately, `usdPerNative` is the chain's coin's rate when a
current one is available.

asOf.description: When the newest reading was taken

usdPerNative.description:
USD per whole unit of the chain's coin (ETH, BNB, POL, SOL…), a decimal string: what a
dollar-priced SKU paid in the coin would convert at now. Left out when no current rate is
available, independently of the token's rate; `source`, `asOf` and `unavailable` describe
the token's rate only.

usdPerToken.description: USD per whole token, a decimal string

sellerType.description: How the store's owner declares it sells; absent when it has not said

tokenAddress.description: The token the store is priced in (the token page's own token)

title: Find a token's store
